description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing articles within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting articles, as well as private helper methods for related data fetching and processing.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Article
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing article-related actions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list articles, fetches project data, and prepares articles with associated units and URLs.

methods.name: new_article
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new article.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures an article by ID and stashes it for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for an existing article, including units in use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new article, delegating to update_or_insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing article, delegating to update_or_insert.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an article if it is not used in dishes or recipes.

methods.name: fetch_project_data
methods.description: Private method to fetch default project data such as shelf life, units, and shop sections.

methods.name: dishes_recipes
methods.description: Collects related recipes linked to dishes and independent dishes, preparing data for views.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Handles validation and persistence of article data, including tags and units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the articles index page.
